How much does it cost to run a clothes steamer?

A typical clothes steamer uses about 1,500 watts (1,000–2,000W depending on the model). Used for 10 minutes per use, 2 uses a week, it costs about 6.6p per use and £6.84 a year at the current price cap rate.

Cost per use
6.6p
About £6.84 a year at 10 minutes per use, 2 uses a week.

Standing charge not included.

About these figures

Source for the typical figure: Typical range (estimate). See how we calculate.

Ways to cut the cost

  • Wash at 30°C and run full loads.
  • Spin at the highest speed the fabric allows before drying.
  • Dry outside or on an airer when you can; heat is the expensive part.

Questions

How much does it cost to run a clothes steamer per hour?

At 26.32p/kWh, a 1500W model costs about 39p an hour while it's running.

How much does it cost to run a clothes steamer per year?

About £6.84 a year, based on 10 minutes per use, 2 uses a week. Change the sliders above to match how you use yours.

Is the standing charge included?

No. You pay the standing charge every day whether or not the appliance is used, so it isn't part of the cost of running it.

How do I find my clothes steamer's actual power use?

Check the rating label, plug or manual for the wattage, or the energy label for kWh figures. A plug-in energy monitor shows exactly what it uses.
